title: Raised With Christ
speaker: Pastor Billy Philips
summary: Week five turns from tearing down to building up, and everything hangs on three words. If then you have been raised with Christ. The command always comes after the identity, so you do not put the old self to death in order to become new. You put it to death because you already are. Take off the old on purpose, put on the new self God already gave you, and let the peace of Christ make the call.
subtitle: You were raised with Christ. Now live like it.
